_comment: Salted SHA-256 hashes of lowercased tokens that must not appear in this repository.
Plaintext is intentionally absent: a readable list would disclose the very terms it
guards. This is obfuscation, not secrecy — the salt is public, so a guess can be
confirmed; it prevents casual reading, grep and search-engine indexing.
Add an entry with:  node scripts/check-sensitive-terms.mjs --add "Term"
